about: Parser benchmark for Cohort Studio. Each case is a plain-English request plus the gold steps a careful analyst would write. evals/build_expected.py runs the gold steps through the engine (with the inflation fix, like the CLI) and freezes the sample IDs in evals/expected/<id>.csv. 'split': tune prompts on 'dev' only; report 'holdout' as the honest number. 'why' records any judgement call so reviewers can challenge it. Do NOT copy these requests into the prompt examples in cohort_studio/llm.py.

cases.request: primary tumors with both RNA and protein data and a diagnostic slide
cases.why: The brief's live demo; the slide join inflates 731 samples to 776 rows.

cases.request: primary tumours that have at least one frozen-section slide
cases.why: Frozen = all three frozen section kinds (top, middle, bottom).

cases.request: tumor samples with copy-number data and any pathology slide
cases.why: 'tumor samples' = primary tumors; 'any pathology slide' = any slide kind.

cases.request: metastatic samples that have protein (RPPA) data
cases.why: Metastatic only, no primary tumors.

cases.request: solid tissue normal samples with RNA-seq
cases.why: Normal-tissue samples, not tumors.

cases.request: primary tumors and metastases with protein data
cases.why: Two sample types; no one-per-patient was asked for, so patients with both keep both.

cases.request: every sample in the release, of any type, that has a diagnostic FFPE slide
cases.why: All three sample types.

cases.request: one sample per patient across all sample types, RNA required
cases.why: Default priority: primary tumor, then metastatic, then normal; ties to the lowest barcode.

cases.request: for each patient keep the earliest collected sample among primary tumors and metastases
cases.why: Earliest by days_to_collection; a clinical join is needed to read it.

cases.request: the most recent sample per patient, any sample type
cases.why: 'Most recent' = latest collection day.

cases.request: primary tumours from patients who also have a normal tissue sample
cases.why: Only the tumors are in the cohort; the normal sample is a condition, not a member.

cases.request: tumor-normal pairs: primary tumors together with their matched normal samples
cases.why: Pairs: both the tumor and the normal sample IDs go in cohort_samples.csv.

cases.request: ER-positive primary tumors, joining clinical records by patient barcode
cases.why: Joining on patient inflates for patients with a normal sample; the fix re-keys on sample_id.

cases.request: stage II primary tumors with survival data, clinical joined on patient ID
cases.why: Generic 'survival data' = has a curated survival record; stage II covers IIA and IIB.

cases.request: ER-positive, HER2-negative breast cancers
cases.why: Clinical IHC status is the default label source. Equivocal HER2 is not negative.

cases.request: triple-negative tumours with RNA expression
cases.why: Triple-negative = ER, PR and HER2 all negative by clinical IHC (not PAM50 basal).

cases.request: HER2-positive by IHC
cases.why: No sample type named -> primary tumors. HER2-positive (IHC), not PAM50 HER2-enriched.

cases.request: HER2-enriched tumors (PAM50)
cases.why: HER2-enriched is a PAM50 RNA subtype, not the IHC status.

cases.request: PAM50 basal-like tumours that are ER-negative by IHC
cases.why: Two label sources at once: PAM50 subtype and IHC receptor status.

cases.request: luminal A or B primary tumors with RPPA protein data
cases.why: 'luminal A or B' = both luminal PAM50 subtypes.

cases.request: primary tumors with a PAM50 call and a diagnostic slide
cases.why: Any recorded PAM50 subtype.

cases.request: ER-positive tumours according to the 2012 TCGA Nature paper labels
cases.why: Named label source: the 2012 Nature column, not the clinical IHC column (they disagree on coverage).

cases.request: PR-negative cancers with copy-number data
cases.why: 'cancers' = primary tumors.

cases.request: stage III or IV primary tumors with overall survival recorded
cases.why: A named endpoint -> survival join plus 'OS recorded'.

cases.request: infiltrating lobular carcinomas in patients aged 50 or older
cases.why: '50 or older' includes 50.

cases.request: postmenopausal patients with invasive ductal carcinoma and RNA data
cases.why: Invasive ductal = TCGA's 'Infiltrating Ductal Carcinoma'. Peri-menopausal is not post, and a bare 'post' would also match 'Indeterminate (neither Pre or Postmenopausal)' (27 samples), so this looks for 'post ('.

cases.request: early-stage (stage I–II) tumors from patients younger than 40
cases.why: 'younger than 40' excludes 40 (integer ages).

cases.request: primary tumours from patients who died, with a diagnostic slide
cases.why: Died = overall-survival event (OS = 1).

cases.request: TP53-mutated primary tumors with progression-free interval data
cases.why: Gene-level MC3 call; PFI endpoint recorded.

cases.request: PIK3CA wild-type, ER-positive primary tumors
cases.why: Wild-type = assessed and not mutated (samples without mutation data are excluded).

cases.request: male breast cancer patients
cases.why: Primary tumors from patients recorded as male.

cases.request: CDH1-mutant lobular tumours with a frozen slide, one sample per patient
cases.why: Everything at once; one-per-patient goes last.

cases.request: basal-like tumors from patients over 60
cases.why: 'over 60' excludes 60 (integer ages).

cases.request: I need tumour samples that have RNA-seq and RPPA, plus at least one FFPE diagnostic slide
cases.why: Paraphrase of brief_demo: same answer, different wording.

cases.request: ER+/HER2- primary breast tumors
cases.why: Paraphrase of er_pos_her2_neg: same answer, different wording.

cases.request: tumors negative for ER, PR and HER2 that have gene expression data
cases.why: Paraphrase of tnbc_rna: same answer, different wording.

cases.request: primary tumors where the same patient also contributed adjacent normal tissue
cases.why: Paraphrase of matched_normal: same answer, different wording.

cases.request: RNA-profiled samples of any type, but count each patient only once
cases.why: Paraphrase of opp_all_rna: same answer, different wording.

cases.request: lobular breast cancer, age at diagnosis >= 50
cases.why: Paraphrase of lobular_50plus: same answer, different wording.

cases.request: deceased patients' primary tumors that have DX slides
cases.why: Paraphrase of died_dx: same answer, different wording.

cases.request: first-collected specimen per patient, considering tumor and metastatic samples
cases.why: Paraphrase of earliest_pt_met: same answer, different wording.

cases.request: matched tumor/normal pairs, keeping both samples of each pair
cases.why: Paraphrase of tn_pairs: same answer, different wording.

cases.request: tumors scored HER2-positive on immunohistochemistry
cases.why: Paraphrase of her2_ihc: same answer, different wording.
